question: According to the Census of India 2011, which of the following Union Territories has the lowest density of population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Andaman and Nicobar Islands.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The** concentration of individuals** within a species in a given geographic location is referred to as **population density.**
 
• Data on population density can be used to calculate demographics and examine interactions with **ecosystems, human health, and infrastructure.**
 
• Population density is usually quoted **per square kilometre or square mile.**
 
• **Population Density of Union Territories**:
 
 
• Andaman & Nicobar Islands : 46
 
• Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu: 2,867
 
• Puducherry: 2,598
 
• Chandigarh: 9,252
 
• Lakshadweep: 2,013
 
• Delhi: 11,297
 
• Jammu and Kashmir: 56
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• State with Highest Population Density: **Bihar**
 
• State with Lowest Population Density:** Arunachal Pradesh**
 
• Union Territory with Highest Population Density: **Delhi**
 
• Union Territory with Lowest Population Density: **Andaman & Nicobar Islands**
 
• District with Highest Density: **North East Delhi**
 
• District with Lowest Density: **Lahaul and Spiti**
